feel I need to leave some feedback, as I want everyone who works in Martine Medical Group, Blyth — from the doctors to the reception staff — to know how much they are appreciated.

I moved to this medical practice two years ago. At first, I was sceptical about contacting them at all due to my previous negative experiences with another surgery. For a long time, I even preferred to go abroad for any health-related issues rather than seek help locally.

However, the experience I’ve had with this practice has been truly exceptional. The doctors and staff are lovely, empathetic, understanding, and always take the time to explain things clearly. They offer advice without ever being dismissive, and they work with such a positive and professional attitude.

Every single member of the team, from the receptionists to the doctors, deserves recognition. I cannot thank them enough, and I want them to know how deeply they are
